no-restricted-syntax.message: Pass timeZone: PKT_TIME_ZONE (lib/utils/format-date) and a locale, so the server (UTC) and browsers print the same date (React #418).
Pass a locale (e.g. "en-US") — and for dates timeZone: PKT_TIME_ZONE — so the server and browsers print the same text (React #418).
